audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Printed transport coupling reverses the Brownian sign; Uniform-in-time Sobolev localization smallness is false; Strong-error proof drops diffusion forcing and uses an unprovided sigma regularity
limitations: P1 — Printed transport coupling reverses the Brownian sign — Counterevidence: The opposite drivers have the same marginal Brownian law, but that does not identify the strong coupling on which (8.6) is based.

P2 — Uniform-in-time Sobolev localization smallness is false — Counterevidence: Absolute continuity gives this smallness for one fixed gradient and fixed time; it does not give uniformity over a bounded family of Lp functions.

P3 — Strong-error proof drops diffusion forcing and uses an unprovided sigma regularity — Counterevidence: The final claimed rate contains a diffusion-error contribution; abstract language suggests sigma Holder regularity may have been intended. Neither observation validates the printed intermediate estimate.
P4 — Gaussian difference bound uses an impossibly narrow envelope — Counterevidence: Precision-matrix notation would change the direction, but the source explicitly uses variance/covariance notation.
P5 — Covariance and Duhamel factors are inconsistent — Counterevidence: A uniform covariance convention cannot reconcile both the actual random variable in (5.3) and the printed factors.
P6 — Proposition 4.6(b) has the wrong control power — Counterevidence: Part(a), Theorem6.1(iii), and Theorem2.3(iii) already print w0^(1/q).

P7 — Girsanov density uses the wrong direction/process — Counterevidence: One can consistently start from the drifted process with the negative density, or from the driftless process with the positive density. The printed process/direction choice does neither.
P8 — Negative-order multiplier norm is used in place of positive order — Counterevidence: The actual g=grad U has the positive-order Lq_t L^(1,p)_x bound by (7.2), with p>d.
Limitations: No assertion of whole-paper failure.
Limitations: No final main SDE theorem counterexample established.
Limitations: Targeted newer-version comparison only; journal typeset full text not acquired.
Limitations: External literature dependencies not all independently reproved.

proposition.claim:
Recorded check: Printed transport coupling reverses the Brownian sign

d=1, b=bn=0, p=q=p1=q1=4, nu=0, l=2, rbar=8, rho(x)=exp(-(x-1)^2). Zero drift satisfies Condition B, and all three strict parameter conditions hold. rho belongs to every required W1r.

Recorded check: Uniform-in-time Sobolev localization smallness is false

d=1, p0=4, p=2, q=4; f=g=0. rj=2^-j, phi=(1-u^2)^2 on [-1,1] and zero outside; a=2+rj^(3/4)phi(x/rj) on disjoint positive-length time intervals (2^(-j-1),2^-j]. Else a=2. Measurable, 2<=a<=3, weak derivative uniformly bounded in L4, and 1/p+1/p0<1.

Recorded check: Strong-error proof drops diffusion forcing and uses an unprovided sigma regularity

First example: d=1, b=bn=0, U=0, x0=x0n=0, sigma=1+tanh(x)/4, n=1, p=q=p0=4, q0=infinity, pbar=2, alpha=1. Smooth bounded uniformly elliptic Lipschitz sigma and integrable gradient satisfy all conditions. Separate regularity example: d=2, p=q=8, p0=4, q0=infinity, b=bn=0, sigma a rotation of angle cutoff*|x|^(3/4), a=I, alpha=1.

Recorded check: Gaussian difference bound uses an impossibly narrow envelope

d=1, positive scalar covariances Sigma=1 and barSigma=2, K=2, satisfying the lemma's comparability assumptions.

Recorded check: Covariance and Duhamel factors are inconsistent

First test sigma=1, f=cos(x). Second test d=1, smooth a=1+exp(-x^2)/2, sigma=sqrt(a), f=1, s=0, 0<t<1/n. These are smooth bounded uniformly elliptic admissible coefficients.

Recorded check: Proposition 4.6(b) has the wrong control power

d=1,p=q=4,pbar=1, g_epsilon=epsilon*f, f smooth compactly supported nonnegative nonzero with L4 norm one; w0(s,t)=epsilon^4(t-s), Gamma=1. Bessel potential order -1 is an L4 contraction.

Recorded check: Girsanov density uses the wrong direction/process

Take sigma=1 and smooth compactly supported bn=b equal to one near the initial point; all drift integrability/local boundedness assumptions hold. Density is exp(-integral u dB -1/2 integral |u|2).

Recorded check: Negative-order multiplier norm is used in place of positive order

d=1,p=2,q=10 satisfies d/p+4/q<1. For smooth compactly supported nonzero psi, gk=hk=psi cos(kx), constant in time.

Retained report, Problem 7: Problem 7 (Minor: the change-of-measure direction in (5.33) is reversed).
